anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: Flows were 0.076 and 0.423 L/h, while FYI702 was 3.643; the reported ratio does not match the instantaneous reflux/distillate flow ratio.
Distillate flow increased to 0.658 L/h and PDI702 to 3.703 mbar from 0.423 L/h and 2.004 mbar one minute earlier; system pressure was 298.233 mbar.

Distillate flow and PDI702 partially recovered to 0.501 L/h and 2.244 mbar; reflux was 0.234 L/h and FYI702 3.643. System pressure remained near baseline at 299.184 mbar, and both level switches remained 1.

args.missing_evidence: Protocol flow targets, allowed transients and commanded changes; FYI702 definition and averaging interval; independent or synchronized flow verification to resolve the apparent ratio discrepancy; composition measurement and separation acceptance criterion. Installed temperature measurements are unavailable in the supplied manifest.
